question: Which café are available within 80 kilometers along the corridor from Greenpoint Gallery, Brooklyn, NY to Hotel Belnord, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.95243 40.736354)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.975273 40.788788)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.95243 40.736354)',4326)::geography, 80000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.95243 40.736354)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
